LaunchOfferCounter.title: LaunchOfferCounter
LaunchOfferCounter.description: Global atomic counter tracking total installations assigned to 365-user launch offer batches.

count.description: Monotonically increasing integer count of assigned installations.

lastUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who performed the latest atomic +1 increment.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest counter increment.

LaunchOfferClaim.title: LaunchOfferClaim
LaunchOfferClaim.description: Per-installation immutable record ensuring each anonymous UID increments the launch counter at most once.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the claimant (must match document ID).

userNumber.description: Sequential 1-based installation number assigned from LaunchOfferCounter.

batch.description: Assigned launch batch: 1 (users 1..365, 100% off Lifetime), 2 (users 366..730, 100% off 1-Year), or 0 (users >730, regular price).

claimedAt.description: Server timestamp when the installation claimed its batch slot.

/launch_offer/{docId}.description: Singleton counter document (/launch_offer/counter) incremented by +1 in an atomic transaction alongside /launch_claims/{uid}.

/launch_claims/{uid}.description: One-time claim document per Firebase Auth UID preventing duplicate increments.
